question: Which symbols for Ellis's (2012) Saipan Carolinian bʷˠ, mʷˠ, pʷˠː and ʈʂ͡:ʲ, and are the Carolinian rows of Bender et al. (2003a) respelled to them?
chosen_reading: bʷˠ, mʷˠ, pʷˠː = bʷ, mʷ, pʷː (as in the other Chuukic lects); ʈʂ͡:ʲ = ʈ͡ʂː, the palatalization mark dropped (it only keeps the symbol in Woleaian's column, p. 151). The rows of Bender et al. (2003a) already write these sounds as Ellis does (bʷ, ʂ, x, l), so none needs respelling; the orthography note of caro1242 changes to IPA with Ellis's inventory (sheet edit). The rows of Jackson (1984, 1986) with k, ʈ͡ʂ and pʷ (single) keep their symbols and give warnings: Ellis has these only as geminates.
alternatives: Keep Ellis's symbols as printed (bʷˠ, ʈʂ͡:ʲ); or respell the k, ʈ͡ʂ, pʷ rows of Jackson to kː, ʈ͡ʂː, pʷː.
